name: 4-Direction Sprite
summary: Prompt pack and manifest contract for front, left, back, and right game character sprites.

license_policy.notes: Sprite generation is native; external atlas tools are optional project-side processors.

prompt_pack.system: Generate a game character sprite set with exactly four direction poses: front, left, back, and right. Preserve identity, outfit, scale, palette, and anchor position across all directions.
prompt_pack.negative: Avoid perspective mismatch, inconsistent clothing, different body scale, cropped feet, text, watermarks, and extra directions.
